shared_results: HyperMath should first be proof-carrying algebraic IR, not a distinct runtime organ.
UnifiedDB may compile HyperIR through conventional factorized/FAQ/GDL-style backends when law/context/read-set witnesses permit.
GRF possible worlds should lower into the same HyperIR while preserving reality class, uncertainty, causal parent and provenance.
Simulation must be selected by calibrated expected net value, not uncertainty alone.
Thin semantic handles must bind semantic root + state epoch + execution generation + delivery generation.
Semantic higher-order irreducibility must be distinguished from operational implementation via relation nodes/hidden state.
No current evidence supports formal super-Turing computation.

claycode: Add/retain carrier-specific LawCertificate and RewriteWitness primitives in typed IR.
Compiler must expose complete/conservative material read summaries before exact cross-alternative reuse or factorization.
RealityBranch/PossibleWorldSet lowering must preserve hard epistemic and causal fields.
unifieddb: Treat HyperIR as algebraic query/preprocessing input; compare strongest conventional FAQ/factorized baseline before new runtime layer.
Cache/rewrite keys include semantic root, state epoch, carrier/law version and material read signature.
Persist generation-fence data needed for safe handle replay/recovery.
claygraph: Keep canonical n-ary semantic identity distinct from operational relation-node/incidence representation.
Expose context-smuggling and pairwise-reduction controls in topology diagnostics.
gwt: Consume bounded HyperCapsule/PossibleWorldSet candidates; GWT selects scarce use, not truth.
SimulationBid should compete with observe/retrieve/act/ask/stop under total cognition cost.
clayresearch_grf: Unify C-GRF branch state with HyperIR rather than creating a second possible-world store.
Keep reality contamination firewall and realized-outcome reconciliation mandatory.
Replace uncertainty-only simulation heuristic with calibrated net-value policy.
go: Hyperposition transport consumes fresh GO continuity result: stale execution or delivery generations invalidate semantic handles.
Response replay may reuse exact stored HyperIR handles only as provenance-bound replay, never fresh cognition.
frank: Target discriminator should compare plain UDB, strongest conventional factorized planner, HyperMath PCIR, and HyperMath+GRF under matched budget.
Do not gate v0.1 on visual Generated-Reality backend; semantic/causal GRF core is sufficient for first integration.

hypotheses: H-HM-1 proof-carrying HyperIR reduces duplicated semantic logic and unsound rewrites.
H-HM-2 persistent catalytic semantic structure changes practical compute geometry while remaining ordinarily computable until contrary proof.
H-HM-3 GRF/Hyperposition unification reduces branch duplication and reality contamination.
H-HM-4 calibrated selective simulation improves realized target utility per cognition cost.
H-HM-5 generation-fenced thin handles preserve transport savings without stale semantic splice.
H-HM-6 some target interactions remain causally irreducible under strongest pairwise/state-machine controls.
counterhypotheses: H0-1 conventional FAQ/factorized planner dominates distinct HyperMath runtime.
H0-2 LawCertificate machinery is redundant with ordinary compiler/type/test infrastructure.
H0-3 explicit GRF SimulationBid provides no gain over existing Frank recurrence/GWT allocation.
H0-4 thin-net invalidation/recovery overhead erases wire/context savings.
H0-5 higher-order semantics are descriptive only; pairwise/state-machine operational reductions match real interventions/outcomes.
H0-6 all observed gains are ordinary computation and do not expand computability class.
negative_results: Initial uncertainty-heavy GRF gate lost to ALWAYS_SIMULATE and was rejected.
No evidence justifies a distinct HyperMath runtime yet.
No evidence justifies formal super-Turing language.
Synthetic factorization speedup is not target-live evidence.
next_discriminator: Current accepted target VPS A/B/C/D replay with real Frank traces and matched semantics/model/seeds/effect-policy/cognition-budget.
